textRuns.value: How to read: each result compares flats that are alike in size, type, design, floor, lease and month of sale, so the difference shows the effect of the one factor named. Like-for-like trend = price change for the same kind of flat; the headline trend also moves when a different mix of flats is sold.

These are patterns in past sales, not proof of cause: exact location, condition and views also matter. Results are fixed calculations and do not change with filters. Details: docs/HYPOTHESIS_REGISTER.md.
